messages.content: Hey, it's your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you feeling this week? Share your latest blood pressure reading whenever you're ready.
139/90 this morning. Doing alright I guess. Bigger problem is I ran out of lisinopril two days ago. Pharmacy says they need a new script from my doctor before they'll fill it again.

Got it, logging that reading now. Running out of your blood pressure medication is something a nurse needs to see — I'm escalating this to the care team right now. That's not something I can sort out from my end, but they can.
Appreciate it. The pharmacy is nearly 40 miles away so it's not like I can just drive over and figure it out same day.

I hear you — that's a real hassle. I'm not able to help with transportation or insurance, and I can't contact the pharmacy directly. The nurse who picks this up will be better placed to work through the options with you. Median response time right now is 31 hours. If you get a severe headache, chest pain, or feel unusually short of breath before then, don't wait — call 911.
31 hours is a while. Nothing I can do in the meantime?

I can't give medical or diet advice — that's squarely for your nurse and doctor. Keep watching for any new symptoms and reach out to them directly if anything changes. I'll set your next check-in for seven days out. Hang in there.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
